entries.doc: Multiply the arguments; no arguments gives 1.
adds numbers. No arguments gives 0.
Subtract subsequent arguments from the first; one argument negates.
Divide left to right; one argument takes the reciprocal. Exact integer divisions stay integers; others produce floats. Zero divisors raise an error.
Test whether adjacent numbers are strictly increasing. Requires at least two arguments; integers and floats can be mixed.
Test whether adjacent numbers are nondecreasing. Requires at least two arguments; integers and floats can be mixed.
Test whether adjacent numbers are equal. Zero or one argument gives #t; integers and floats can be mixed.
Test whether adjacent numbers are strictly decreasing. Requires at least two arguments; integers and floats can be mixed.
Test whether adjacent numbers are nonincreasing. Requires at least two arguments; integers and floats can be mixed.

entries.name: abs
entries.doc: Return the absolute value.

entries.name: acos
entries.doc: Compute inverse cosine in radians.

entries.name: and
entries.doc: Evaluate left to right until a falsy result; return the last result, or #t with no arguments.

entries.name: append
entries.doc: Concatenate proper lists into a list. Dotted tails are rejected.

entries.name: apply
entries.doc: Call procedure with the leading arguments followed by the elements of a proper list or array; nil contributes no arguments.

entries.name: array
entries.doc: Construct a mutable array. [a b c] is array literal syntax.

entries.name: array-to-list
entries.doc: Convert an array to a new list; other input types raise an error.

entries.name: array?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is an array, otherwise #f.

entries.name: asin
entries.doc: Compute inverse sine in radians.

entries.name: assoc
entries.doc: The first pair in alist whose car is equal? to key, or nil.

entries.name: assq
entries.doc: The first pair in alist whose car is eq? to key, or nil.

entries.name: atan
entries.doc: Return arctangent in radians; two arguments use the quadrant-aware angle of y/x.

entries.name: begin
entries.doc: Evaluate expressions in order and return the last result, or nil for no expressions.

entries.name: bitwise-and
entries.doc: Bitwise AND of exact integers; no arguments gives -1.

entries.name: bitwise-arithmetic-shift
entries.doc: Shift an exact integer left by count bits, or right with sign extension for a negative count. C raises an error if the result exceeds its integer range.

entries.name: bitwise-ior
entries.doc: Bitwise inclusive OR of exact integers; no arguments gives 0.

entries.name: bitwise-not
entries.doc: Complement the bits of one exact integer.

entries.name: bitwise-xor
entries.doc: Bitwise exclusive OR of exact integers; no arguments gives 0.

entries.name: boolean?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is #t or #f, otherwise #f.

entries.name: buffer
entries.doc: Create a mutable string builder, optionally initialized from the value's display representation.

entries.name: buffer->string
entries.doc: Return a string snapshot; the buffer remains available for further appends.

entries.name: buffer-push!
entries.doc: Append display representations to the buffer and return it.

entries.name: buffer?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a mutable string buffer, otherwise #f.

entries.name: bytevector
entries.doc: Create a fresh mutable bytevector. Each byte must be an exact integer from 0 to 255.

entries.name: bytevector-append
entries.doc: Concatenate bytevectors into a fresh bytevector.

entries.name: bytevector-copy
entries.doc: Copy the half-open byte range into a fresh bytevector. Defaults to the whole bytevector.

entries.name: bytevector-copy!
entries.doc: Copy a half-open range from from into to at byte index at. Overlapping ranges are supported. Return nil.

entries.name: bytevector-length
entries.doc: Return the number of bytes.

entries.name: bytevector-u8-ref
entries.doc: Return the byte at index. Raise an error for an invalid index.

entries.name: bytevector-u8-set!
entries.doc: Set the byte at index and return nil. Reject invalid indexes and values outside 0 to 255.

entries.name: bytevector?
entries.doc: Test whether value is a bytevector.

entries.name: caaar
entries.doc: Equivalent to (car (car (car pair))).

entries.name: caadr
entries.doc: Equivalent to (car (car (cdr pair))).

entries.name: caar
entries.doc: Equivalent to (car (car pair)).

entries.name: cadar
entries.doc: Equivalent to (car (cdr (car pair))).

entries.name: cadddr
entries.doc: Equivalent to (car (cdr (cdr (cdr pair)))).

entries.name: caddr
entries.doc: Equivalent to (car (cdr (cdr pair))).

entries.name: cadr
entries.doc: Equivalent to (car (cdr pair)).

entries.name: call-with-cleanup
entries.doc: Call body with no arguments and cleanup with its exit outcome on every exit. The outcome is nil on return or restart transfer, the condition on error, or :quit on exit or interrupt. Cleanup errors replace the pending result. Reentry through a continuation is unsupported.

entries.name: car
entries.doc: Return the head of a pair. Passing an empty list or another type raises an error.

entries.name: case
entries.doc: Evaluate expression once and run the first equal? literal clause. Return nil if none matches.

entries.name: cdaar
entries.doc: Equivalent to (cdr (car (car pair))).

entries.name: cdadr
entries.doc: Equivalent to (cdr (car (cdr pair))).

entries.name: cdar
entries.doc: Equivalent to (cdr (car pair)).

entries.name: cddar
entries.doc: Equivalent to (cdr (cdr (car pair))).

entries.name: cdddr
entries.doc: Equivalent to (cdr (cdr (cdr pair))).

entries.name: cddr
entries.doc: Equivalent to (cdr (cdr pair)).

entries.name: cdr
entries.doc: Return the tail of a pair. Passing an empty list or another type raises an error.

entries.name: ceiling
entries.doc: Round up to an integer.

entries.name: char->integer
entries.doc: The Unicode code point of char.

entries.name: char-alphabetic?
entries.doc: Test for a letter. ASCII-only on C.

entries.name: char-downcase
entries.doc: Lowercase an ASCII letter; other chars are returned unchanged on C.

entries.name: char-numeric?
entries.doc: Test for a decimal digit. ASCII-only on C.

entries.name: char-upcase
entries.doc: Uppercase an ASCII letter; other chars are returned unchanged on C.

entries.name: char-whitespace?
entries.doc: Test for whitespace. ASCII-only on C.

entries.name: char<=?
entries.doc: Test whether chars are in nondecreasing code point order.

entries.name: char<?
entries.doc: Test whether chars are in strictly increasing code point order.

entries.name: char=?
entries.doc: Test whether all chars are the same.

entries.name: char>=?
entries.doc: Test whether chars are in nonincreasing code point order.

entries.name: char>?
entries.doc: Test whether chars are in strictly decreasing code point order.

entries.name: char?
entries.doc: Test whether value is a char.

entries.name: clamp
entries.doc: Clamp value to the inclusive interval from low to high.

entries.name: class-mount
entries.doc: Copy current-layout properties to a new instance and initialize its state slots. Does not repeat property initializers. Rejects stale descriptions after class redefinition.

entries.name: class-properties
entries.doc: Construct properties for a fresh description. Reject state initargs, evaluate property defaults, and fill state slots with nil without evaluating their initializers. Used by otium.ui.

entries.name: class-subtype?
entries.doc: Test whether child is parent or descends from it through abstract parents. Both arguments must be class descriptors.

entries.name: class-update-properties!
entries.doc: Update an instance from current-layout properties of the same class, preserving state slots. During migration, supplies new required properties before update-instance runs. Returns the original instance; a failed migration restores its old layout and slots.

entries.name: close
entries.doc: Generic procedure.

entries.name: close-input-port
entries.doc: Close an input port. Closing twice does nothing.

entries.name: close-output-port
entries.doc: Flush and close an output port. Closing twice does nothing.

entries.name: close-port
entries.doc: Flush an output port and close the port. Closing twice does nothing.

entries.name: compute-restarts
entries.doc: Return an array of active restarts, innermost first.

entries.name: concat
entries.doc: Concatenation; kind follows the first argument (nil -> list).

entries.name: cond
entries.doc: Evaluate the first matching clause. else is the final fallback clause.

entries.name: condition-message
entries.doc: Return a condition table's :message, or nil.

entries.name: condition-of-type?
entries.doc: Test whether a condition has the named type or a registered subtype.

entries.name: condition-type
entries.doc: Return a condition table's :type, or nil.

entries.name: cons
entries.doc: Construct a pair. A proper list ends in () or nil.

entries.name: contains?
entries.doc: Test table key presence, equal? membership in a sequence, or substring presence in a string. nil returns #f.

entries.name: copy
entries.doc: Make a shallow copy of an array, table, or instance; nil returns nil. Instances keep their class, migrate if needed, and share the objects held in their slots.

entries.name: cos
entries.doc: Compute cosine in radians.

entries.name: count
entries.doc: Like length, but nil counts as zero.

entries.name: current-directory
entries.doc: Return the current working directory as an absolute path.

entries.name: current-error-port
entries.doc: The dynamically scoped error output port. Rebind with with-params.

entries.name: current-input-port
entries.doc: The dynamically scoped default input port. Rebind with with-params.

entries.name: current-jiffy
entries.doc: Return a monotonic nanosecond counter with an unspecified epoch; subtract readings to measure elapsed time.

entries.name: current-ns
entries.doc: Return the current namespace name as a symbol.

entries.name: current-output-port
entries.doc: The dynamically scoped default output port. Rebind with with-params.

entries.name: current-second
entries.doc: Return wall-clock seconds since the Unix epoch as a float.

entries.name: dec
entries.doc: Subtract one.

entries.name: declare-record!
entries.doc: Reuse an unchanged record declaration; reject changes to fields or mutability.

entries.name: def
entries.doc: Define or replace a binding. Namespace bindings are live across redefinition. Allowed at top level and in bodies.

entries.name: def-
entries.doc: Define or replace a top-level binding that is private to its namespace.

entries.name: defabstract
entries.doc: Declare a slotless abstract type for dispatch. Parents must be abstract and acyclic; the default parent is Object. Abstract types cannot be instantiated.

entries.name: defclass
entries.doc: Declare a final class with fixed slots. Slot options are :init expression, :accessor generic, and :state boolean. State slots require :init; ordinary make treats them like other slots. Reload preserves class identity and lazily migrates instances; changing a slot between property and state resets it.

entries.name: defer
entries.doc: Run cleanup on normal return and on unwinding. Return expression's value unless cleanup raises a new condition.

entries.name: defgeneric
entries.doc: Declare a fixed-arity generic. Reload preserves its identity and methods.

entries.name: define-condition
entries.doc: Register a condition type and parent for condition-of-type? checks; use nil for no parent.

entries.name: defmacro
entries.doc: Define an unhygienic Otium macro. It receives unevaluated argument datums and returns replacement code; use gensym for fresh names.

entries.name: defmethod
entries.doc: Add or replace a method by qualifier and signature. :next binds a lexical procedure for the remaining methods, or #f when none remain. Pass every argument explicitly. Around methods wrap primary methods; incomparable applicable methods are ambiguous.

entries.name: defonce
entries.doc: Initialize a binding once, preserving its value and documentation on reload.

entries.name: defparam
entries.doc: Define a named dynamically scoped parameter. Call (name) to read it; use with-params to override it temporarily.

entries.name: defrecord
entries.doc: Declare a fixed-layout record type in the current namespace. Fields are mutable by default. An identical declaration reuses its type; changing fields or mutability is an error.

entries.name: delete-file
entries.doc: Delete a file and return nil. Filesystem failures raise file-error.

entries.name: describe
entries.doc: Return namespace/name: docstring for a binding, a no-documentation placeholder for an undocumented binding, or nil for an unknown name. Runtime forms return their shared reference text.

entries.name: digit-value
entries.doc: The value 0 to 9 of an ASCII decimal digit, or nil for any other char.

entries.name: dispatch-type
entries.doc: Return the class used for generic dispatch, including the declared class of an instance.

entries.name: display
entries.doc: Write display representations to the current output port sink, separated by spaces, without a newline. Return nil. Writes to current-output-port.

entries.name: display-to
entries.doc: Write display forms separated by spaces to port and return nil.

entries.name: dissoc
entries.doc: Return a shallow copy without the specified keys.

entries.name: dotimes
entries.doc: Evaluate count once, then run body with index from 0 below count. Return nil.

entries.name: drop
entries.doc: Return the elements after the first count. Count clamps to the available range; preserve list/array kind.

entries.name: empty?
entries.doc: Test whether a sequence, table, string, or buffer has no elements. nil is empty.

entries.name: eof-object
entries.doc: The end-of-file object.

entries.name: eof-object?
entries.doc: Test whether value is the end-of-file object.

entries.name: eq?
entries.doc: Compare immediate values by value and heap objects by identity. Use equal? for structural comparison.

entries.name: equal?
entries.doc: Compare values structurally, including pairs, arrays, tables, and string contents.

entries.name: error
entries.doc: Raise an error condition containing the message and optional arguments; does not return normally.

entries.name: error?
entries.doc: Test whether value is a table with a :type entry.

entries.name: eval
entries.doc: Otium override: expand Otium macros and evaluate form in the namespace where this eval binding was installed. Loader directives and definitions participate in Otium namespace tracking. The caller's lexical bindings are not captured.

entries.name: even?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is an even integer, otherwise #f.

entries.name: exact
entries.doc: Convert an integer-valued finite number to an integer; fractional or out-of-range values raise an error.

entries.name: exact?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is an integer representation, otherwise #f.

entries.name: exists
entries.doc: Return the first truthy predicate result across lists or arrays, or nil. Stop at the shortest input.

entries.name: exit
entries.doc: Request program termination with an optional integer exit status from 0 through 255 (default 0).

entries.name: exp
entries.doc: Compute e raised to the argument as a float.

entries.name: expt
entries.doc: Raise base to exponent. Nonnegative integer powers of integers use integer arithmetic with wrapping overflow; other inputs use floating point.

entries.name: false?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is exactly #f, otherwise #f.

entries.name: file-directory?
entries.doc: Test whether path resolves to a directory. Missing paths return #f.

entries.name: file-exists?
entries.doc: Test whether the path exists. Other filesystem failures raise file-error.

entries.name: file-info
entries.doc: Return a table with :type (:file, :directory, or :other), :size in bytes, and :modified in Unix seconds.

entries.name: file-regular?
entries.doc: Test whether path resolves to a regular file. Missing paths return #f.

entries.name: file-symbolic-link?
entries.doc: Test whether path itself is a symbolic link, including a dangling link.

entries.name: filter
entries.doc: Keep elements for which predicate returns a truthy value; preserve list/array kind.

entries.name: find
entries.doc: Return the first matching element, or nil. Stop at the first match.

entries.name: find-index
entries.doc: Return the index of the first matching element in a list or array, or nil.

entries.name: find-restart
entries.doc: Find the innermost active restart by name, or return nil.

entries.name: finite?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is finite, otherwise #f.

entries.name: first
entries.doc: Return the first element, or nil. On a string, return the first char.

entries.name: float?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a floating-point representation, otherwise #f.

entries.name: floor
entries.doc: Round down to an integer.

entries.name: flush-output-port
entries.doc: Write buffered bytes to the sink and invoke its flush callback.

entries.name: flush-ports!
entries.doc: Flush all open file and custom output ports and the default output and error ports.

entries.name: fn
entries.doc: Create a lexical procedure. Parameters may be a proper list, dotted rest list, (a & rest), or a rest symbol.

entries.name: fold-left
entries.doc: Combine from the left: (procedure accumulator element ...) for each position.

entries.name: fold-right
entries.doc: Combine from the right: (procedure element ... accumulator) for each position.

entries.name: for-all
entries.doc: Return the last predicate result if all positions pass, else the first falsy result. Empty inputs pass.

entries.name: for-each
entries.doc: Call procedure on each element for side effects, then return nil. Traverses a snapshot; accepts a proper list, array, or nil.

entries.name: foreign?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a foreign extension value, otherwise #f.

entries.name: gcd
entries.doc: Greatest common divisor; no arguments gives 0.

entries.name: generic-methods
entries.doc: Return detached (qualifier signature) lists. Qualifiers are primary or :around. Signatures contain class descriptors; Object represents an unspecialized argument.

entries.name: gensym
entries.doc: Return a fresh symbol using the optional string prefix (default G). Useful for avoiding accidental capture in macros.

entries.name: get
entries.doc: Look up a table key or an array/string index. Missing entries and nil collections return default (nil if omitted). String indexing returns a char.

entries.name: get-in
entries.doc: get folded over a sequence of keys.

entries.name: get-output-bytevector
entries.doc: Return a fresh bytevector with the output contents, without consuming them.

entries.name: get-output-string
entries.doc: Return the string port contents without consuming them. Invalid UTF-8 raises decode-error.

entries.name: handler-bind
entries.doc: Evaluate all bindings left to right under the surrounding handlers, then install signal-site handlers for body. Returning from a handler declines the condition.

entries.name: identity
entries.doc: Return value unchanged.

entries.name: if
entries.doc: Evaluate one branch. Only nil and #f are falsy; omitted alternative returns nil.

entries.name: inc
entries.doc: Add one.

entries.name: inexact
entries.doc: Convert a number to a float.

entries.name: inexact?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is a floating-point representation, otherwise #f.

entries.name: infinite?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is positive or negative infinity, otherwise #f.

entries.name: input-port-open?
entries.doc: Test whether value is an open input port.

entries.name: input-port?
entries.doc: Test whether value is an input port.

entries.name: insert-at
entries.doc: Insert before index in a list or array, returning a copy of the same kind.

entries.name: instance?
entries.doc: Test whether value is a class instance. Instances have identity equality and are not tables.

entries.name: int?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is an integer representation, otherwise #f.

entries.name: integer->char
entries.doc: The char with code point n; raise an error for surrogates and values above #x10FFFF.

entries.name: integer?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is an integer value, including integral floats, otherwise #f.

entries.name: invoke-restart
entries.doc: Unwind to the chosen active restart and run its clause with the arguments.

entries.name: is-a?
entries.doc: Test whether value belongs to Class or a descendant, including built-in types. Class must be a class descriptor.

entries.name: jiffies-per-second
entries.doc: Return 1000000000, the number of clock jiffies per second.

entries.name: keys
entries.doc: Return the table's keys in insertion order as an array. nil gives an empty array. This is a collection operation, not Scheme multiple values.

entries.name: keyword
entries.doc: Intern a keyword from a string, symbol, or keyword name.

entries.name: keyword->string
entries.doc: The name of a keyword, without its colon.

entries.name: keyword?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a keyword, otherwise #f.

entries.name: last
entries.doc: Return the last element, or nil.

entries.name: lcm
entries.doc: Least common multiple; no arguments gives 1.

entries.name: length
entries.doc: Count list/array elements, table entries, or string/buffer Unicode code points. Improper lists and unsupported types raise an error.

entries.name: let
entries.doc: Bind names sequentially: later initializers see earlier bindings. Named let creates a recursive loop.

entries.name: list
entries.doc: Construct a proper list of the arguments.

entries.name: list->string
entries.doc: Build a string from a list of chars.

entries.name: list-directory
entries.doc: Return a sorted array of entry names, excluding . and ... Filesystem failures raise file-error.

entries.name: list-ref
entries.doc: The element at index k of a list.

entries.name: list-tail
entries.doc: The list after dropping its first k pairs.

entries.name: list-to-array
entries.doc: Convert a proper list to a new array; other input types raise an error.

entries.name: list?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a proper list (including () and nil-terminated chains), otherwise #f.

entries.name: live
entries.doc: Return a procedure that looks up name on every call in its defining namespace. Saved callbacks then follow redefinition and module reload.

entries.name: log
entries.doc: Compute the natural logarithm as a float.

entries.name: macro?
entries.doc: Return #t for an Otium macro value, otherwise #f. Macros receive unevaluated argument datums during expansion and are not ordinary procedures.

entries.name: macroexpand
entries.doc: Repeatedly expand Otium macros at the head of form until its head is no longer a macro. This may run transformer side effects, but does not evaluate the resulting code or traverse subforms.

entries.name: macroexpand-1
entries.doc: Expand a head Otium macro once in the defining namespace of this binding, or return form unchanged. Do not recursively traverse subforms or evaluate the result.

entries.name: macroexpand-all
entries.doc: Expand every macro call in form, including subforms, as the evaluator would before compiling it.

entries.name: make
entries.doc: Construct a concrete class instance. Supplied keywords must name declared slots; repeated keywords keep the last value. Missing slots evaluate their defaults in declaration order or raise an error when required.

entries.name: make-bytevector
entries.doc: Create a bytevector of non-negative length, filled with fill (default 0). Fill must be a byte from 0 to 255.

entries.name: make-directory
entries.doc: Create a directory and return nil. Filesystem failures raise file-error.

entries.name: make-input-port
entries.doc: Create a buffered input port. :read receives (bytes start end) and returns a positive count or EOF. :close is optional.

entries.name: make-output-port
entries.doc: Create a buffered output port. :write receives (bytes start end) and returns a positive count. :flush and :close are optional.

entries.name: map
entries.doc: Kind-preserving: list in, list out; array in, array out; nil -> ().

entries.name: match
entries.doc: Evaluate value once and run the body of the first clause whose pattern matches and whose guard is truthy, with the pattern's names bound. No match signals match-error. See specs/match.md for patterns.

entries.name: match-error
entries.doc: Signal a match-error condition holding value under :value. A use-value restart returns its argument as the result of the failed match.

entries.name: max
entries.doc: Return the largest of one or more numbers.

entries.name: member
entries.doc: Return the first matching tail of a list or array, or nil.

entries.name: memq
entries.doc: The first tail of list whose car is eq? to value, or nil.

entries.name: merge
entries.doc: New table, left to right; nil arguments skipped.

entries.name: min
entries.doc: Return the smallest of one or more numbers.

entries.name: modulo
entries.doc: Integer modulus with the divisor's sign. Both arguments must be integers; the divisor must be nonzero.

entries.name: name
entries.doc: Return the name of a symbol or keyword as a string; a string is returned unchanged.

entries.name: nan?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is not-a-number, otherwise #f.

entries.name: neg?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is negative, otherwise #f.

entries.name: negative?
entries.doc: Alias for neg?.

entries.name: newline
entries.doc: Write a newline to port, defaulting to current-output-port, and return nil.

entries.name: nil?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is nil, otherwise #f.

entries.name: not
entries.doc: Return #t for nil or #f; every other value, including (), is truthy.

entries.name: ns
entries.doc: Select a namespace. Optional (:require ...) clauses import modules; a loaded module must declare its requested name.

entries.name: nth
entries.doc: Return the element at a zero-based integer index, or nil out of range. Accepts lists, arrays, strings, and nil.

entries.name: null?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is the empty list (), otherwise #f.

entries.name: number->string
entries.doc: Return the number's display representation as a string.

entries.name: number?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is an integer or float, otherwise #f.

entries.name: odd?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is an odd integer, otherwise #f.

entries.name: open-binary-input-file
entries.doc: Alias for open-input-file; all ports support byte and text reads.

entries.name: open-binary-output-file
entries.doc: Alias for open-output-file; all ports support byte and text writes.

entries.name: open-input-bytevector
entries.doc: Open an input port over a snapshot of bytes.

entries.name: open-input-file
entries.doc: Open a buffered byte input port. Options may specify a positive :buffer-size.

entries.name: open-input-string
entries.doc: Open a byte input port over the UTF-8 encoding of text.

entries.name: open-output-bytevector
entries.doc: Create an output port collecting bytes.

entries.name: open-output-file
entries.doc: Open a buffered output port. :if-exists is :truncate (default), :append, or :error. :buffer-size is a positive byte count.

entries.name: open-output-string
entries.doc: Create a byte output port whose contents can be decoded with get-output-string.

entries.name: open-ports
entries.doc: Return an array of open file, custom, and standard ports; excludes memory ports.

entries.name: or
entries.doc: Evaluate left to right until a truthy result; return the last result, or #f with no arguments.

entries.name: output-port-open?
entries.doc: Test whether value is an open output port.

entries.name: output-port?
entries.doc: Test whether value is an output port.

entries.name: pair?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a pair, otherwise #f.

entries.name: path-absolute?
entries.doc: Test whether a POSIX path begins with /.

entries.name: path-last
entries.doc: The final component of a POSIX path, ignoring trailing slashes. / has no component.

entries.name: path-parent
entries.doc: The lexical parent of a POSIX path; / stays / and a bare name has parent "".

entries.name: peek-char
entries.doc: Decode the next character without consuming any bytes, or return EOF.

entries.name: peek-u8
entries.doc: Return the next byte without consuming it, or EOF.

entries.name: pop!
entries.doc: Remove and return the last array element, or nil when empty.

entries.name: port?
entries.doc: Test whether value is an Otium port.

entries.name: pos?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is positive, otherwise #f.

entries.name: positive?
entries.doc: Alias for pos?.

entries.name: print
entries.doc: Write display representations to the current output port sink, separated by spaces, without a newline. Return nil. Writes to current-output-port.

entries.name: println
entries.doc: Write display representations to the current output port sink, separated by spaces, followed by a newline. Return nil. Writes to current-output-port.

entries.name: procedure?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a function or native procedure, otherwise #f.

entries.name: push!
entries.doc: Append values to the array and return it.

entries.name: put
entries.doc: put! on a shallow copy; (put nil ...) builds a fresh table.

entries.name: put!
entries.doc: Mutate a table or array and return it. Table values of nil delete keys. Array indices must already exist; use push! to grow an array.

entries.name: quasiquote
entries.doc: Construct data from a template, evaluating active unquote and unquote-splicing forms.

entries.name: quit
entries.doc: Request program termination; status defaults to 0 and must be an integer from 0 through 255.

entries.name: quote
entries.doc: Return datum without evaluating it.

entries.name: quotient
entries.doc: Integer division truncated toward zero. Both arguments must be integers; the divisor must be nonzero.

entries.name: range
entries.doc: Return an array of integers toward the exclusive end. Defaults: start 0, step 1. Step must be nonzero and may be negative.

entries.name: read
entries.doc: Read one Otium datum, or the EOF object.

entries.name: read-all
entries.doc: Read the remaining input as UTF-8 text. Return an empty string at EOF.

entries.name: read-bytevector
entries.doc: Read up to count bytes, stopping at EOF. Return EOF if none are available; count zero returns an empty bytevector.

entries.name: read-bytevector!
entries.doc: Fill a half-open byte range without allocating a result buffer. Return the byte count, or EOF when no bytes are available.

entries.name: read-char
entries.doc: Read one Unicode scalar, or the EOF object. Invalid UTF-8 raises decode-error at the byte :position.

entries.name: read-file
entries.doc: Read a whole UTF-8 file. Invalid UTF-8 raises decode-error.

entries.name: read-line
entries.doc: Read a line without its newline and preceding carriage return. Preserve a final unterminated line. Return EOF when no text remains.

entries.name: read-string
entries.doc: Parse a datum from a string, or read up to count characters from a port.

entries.name: read-u8
entries.doc: Read a byte as an integer, or the EOF object.

entries.name: read-until
entries.doc: Read characters before the next member of stops, leaving that character unread. Return a string even at EOF.

entries.name: read-while
entries.doc: Read the longest prefix drawn from characters. Return a string even at EOF.

entries.name: record-new
entries.doc: Construct a record with positional values in declaration order. Every field is required.

entries.name: record-ref
entries.doc: Read a record field. Records also support (record :field). Unknown fields are errors.

entries.name: record-set!
entries.doc: Write a mutable record field and return value. Immutable records reject writes; immutability is shallow.

entries.name: record-type
entries.doc: Return the record type descriptor. Records compare by identity, including immutable records.

entries.name: record-type?
entries.doc: Test whether value is a record type descriptor.

entries.name: record?
entries.doc: Test whether value is a record instance.

entries.name: reduce
entries.doc: Fold left, calling (procedure accumulator element) for each element. Empty sequences return initial.

entries.name: remainder
entries.doc: Integer remainder with the dividend's sign. Both arguments must be integers; the divisor must be nonzero.

entries.name: remove-at
entries.doc: Remove the element at index from a list or array, returning a copy of the same kind.

entries.name: remove-method!
entries.doc: Remove a method with the given class/#f signature and return whether one existed. Object and #f both mean unspecialized. The qualifier defaults to primary; :around removes a wrapper.

entries.name: rename-file
entries.doc: Rename a file and return nil. Filesystem failures raise file-error.

entries.name: require
entries.doc: Load a namespace. Grouped and quoted specs are also accepted. Search each path directory for .ot then .scm. Reload reevaluates the namespace, preserving defonce values and effects before an error.

entries.name: reset-class!
entries.doc: Explicitly replace an existing local binding with a fresh concrete class. Old instances and signatures retain the old class identity.

entries.name: reset-generic!
entries.doc: Replace this declaration with a fresh generic of the given arity and no methods.

entries.name: resource-closable?
entries.doc: Test whether close has an applicable method for resource on normal exit.

entries.name: rest
entries.doc: All but the first element, preserving list, array, or string kind.

entries.name: restart-case
entries.doc: Make named recovery clauses available during expression and clause evaluation. invoke-restart unwinds to the selected clause; a clause may invoke itself or a sibling restart.

entries.name: restart-description
entries.doc: Return a restart's description string, or nil if it has none.

entries.name: restart-name
entries.doc: Return a restart's name as a symbol.

entries.name: reverse
entries.doc: Reverse a list or array, preserving its kind. nil is treated as an empty list.

entries.name: round
entries.doc: Round to the nearest integer; halfway cases round away from zero.

entries.name: second
entries.doc: Return element at index 1, or nil.

entries.name: set!
entries.doc: Replace the value of an existing lexical or namespace binding.

entries.name: set-applied!
entries.doc: Assign an instance slot, table key, or existing array index and return value. (set! (object key) value) evaluates object, key, and value once, in that order. Table values of nil delete keys.

entries.name: set-car!
entries.doc: Replace the pair's head and return the pair. Cycles and mutation of pairs frozen as table keys are rejected.

entries.name: set-cdr!
entries.doc: Replace the pair's tail and return the pair. Cycles and mutation of pairs frozen as table keys are rejected.

entries.name: signal
entries.doc: Offer a condition to active handlers before unwinding. Returning from a handler declines; if all decline, return nil (Chez: #f).

entries.name: sin
entries.doc: Compute sine in radians.

entries.name: skip-while
entries.doc: Skip the longest prefix drawn from characters and return its character count.

entries.name: slot-set!
entries.doc: Write a declared slot and return value. Migrates an outdated instance before writing. Read slots by calling the instance: (instance keyword).

entries.name: sort
entries.doc: Return an ascending sorted copy, preserving list/array kind. Keys must belong to a supported, consistent orderable class.

entries.name: sort-by
entries.doc: Stable sort by derived keys; keys must all be one orderable class.

entries.name: sqrt
entries.doc: Compute the square root as a float.

entries.name: str
entries.doc: Concatenate display representations into a string, with no separators. No arguments gives an empty string.

entries.name: string
entries.doc: Build a string from chars.

entries.name: string->list
entries.doc: A list of the chars in string.

entries.name: string->number
entries.doc: Parse a number, returning nil on failure. Chez retains its native numeric tower.

entries.name: string->symbol
entries.doc: Intern a symbol from a string, symbol, or keyword name.

entries.name: string->utf8
entries.doc: Encode a half-open character range as UTF-8 in a fresh bytevector. Defaults to the whole string.

entries.name: string-append
entries.doc: Concatenate strings; non-string arguments raise an error.

entries.name: string-contains?
entries.doc: Return #t if string contains the literal text, otherwise #f.

entries.name: string-downcase
entries.doc: Convert ASCII uppercase letters to lowercase.

entries.name: string-ends-with?
entries.doc: Return #t if string ends with the literal text, otherwise #f.

entries.name: string-index
entries.doc: Find part at or after the optional character offset, or nil. Empty part matches at start.

entries.name: string-join
entries.doc: Join the display representations of sequence elements with separator.

entries.name: string-length
entries.doc: Count Unicode code points, not encoded bytes.

entries.name: string-ref
entries.doc: The char at code point index k; raise an error when out of range. O(k) on C, which stores strings as UTF-8.

entries.name: string-repeat
entries.doc: Repeat text count times; zero gives an empty string.

entries.name: string-replace
entries.doc: Replace every literal occurrence of from with to.

entries.name: string-split
entries.doc: Split into an array on a literal nonempty separator, or on runs of whitespace when omitted.

entries.name: string-starts-with?
entries.doc: Return #t if string starts with the literal text, otherwise #f.

entries.name: string-trim
entries.doc: Remove surrounding ASCII whitespace.

entries.name: string-upcase
entries.doc: Convert ASCII lowercase letters to uppercase.

entries.name: string<=?
entries.doc: Test whether strings are in nondecreasing order.

entries.name: string<?
entries.doc: Test lexicographic string ordering.

entries.name: string=?
entries.doc: Test whether all strings are equal.

entries.name: string>=?
entries.doc: Test whether strings are in nonincreasing order.

entries.name: string>?
entries.doc: Test whether strings are in strictly decreasing order.

entries.name: string?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a string, otherwise #f.

entries.name: substring
entries.doc: Copy code points from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive, default length). Indices clamp to the string bounds; end below start gives an empty string.

entries.name: symbol
entries.doc: Intern a symbol from a string, symbol, or keyword name.

entries.name: symbol->string
entries.doc: Return the symbol's name as a string.

entries.name: symbol-macrolet
entries.doc: Replace references to name with expansion in body. With a writer, (set! name value) becomes (let ((parameter value)) write-form).

entries.name: symbol?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a symbol, otherwise #f.

entries.name: table
entries.doc: Construct an insertion-ordered table. Requires key/value pairs; a nil value removes its key. {key value ...} is table literal syntax.

entries.name: table?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is a table, otherwise #f.

entries.name: take
entries.doc: Return the first count elements. Count clamps to the available range; preserve list/array kind.

entries.name: tan
entries.doc: Compute tangent in radians.

entries.name: third
entries.doc: Return element at index 2, or nil.

entries.name: true?
entries.doc: Return #t when value is exactly #t, otherwise #f.

entries.name: truncate
entries.doc: Round toward zero to an integer.

entries.name: try
entries.doc: Catch an unwinding condition using the first matching predicate. (catch name body ...) catches any condition. quit is not caught.

entries.name: type
entries.doc: Return the value's type as a keyword, such as :int, :string, :array, or :table.

entries.name: type-pred
entries.doc: Build a predicate for conditions of type or its registered subtypes.

entries.name: unless
entries.doc: Evaluate body when test is falsy; otherwise return nil.

entries.name: unquote
entries.doc: Insert an evaluated value into an enclosing quasiquote.

entries.name: unquote-splicing
entries.doc: Splice evaluated sequence elements into an enclosing quasiquote.

entries.name: unwind-protect
entries.doc: Run cleanup on normal return and on unwinding. Return expression's value unless cleanup raises a new condition.

entries.name: update
entries.doc: Copy the collection and replace the entry with (procedure (get collection key) argument ...).

entries.name: update!
entries.doc: Replace the entry with (procedure (get collection key) argument ...). Mutates and returns the collection.

entries.name: update-instance
entries.doc: Generic called after lazy migration. old-slots is a table of the previous keyword slot values. The default does nothing. Methods may initialize newly required slots; a failed migration is retried on the next access.

entries.name: utf8->string
entries.doc: Decode a half-open byte range as UTF-8. Invalid input raises decode-error with the absolute byte offset in :position.

entries.name: values
entries.doc: Return the table's values in insertion order as an array. nil gives an empty array. This is a collection operation, not Scheme multiple values.

entries.name: when
entries.doc: Evaluate body when test is truthy; otherwise return nil.

entries.name: while
entries.doc: Repeat body while test is truthy, then return nil.

entries.name: with
entries.doc: Acquire in order and release in reverse order on every exit. Default release is close.

entries.name: with-output-to-string
entries.doc: Call f with a fresh current output port and return the captured string.

entries.name: with-params
entries.doc: Install dynamic parameter values sequentially for body, restoring them on every exit path.

entries.name: with-slots
entries.doc: Evaluate object once and bind local symbol macros that read and write its slots. Each read sees the current value; set! on a slot name writes through to the object.

entries.name: write
entries.doc: Write readable representations to the current output port sink, separated by spaces, without a newline. Return nil. Writes to current-output-port.

entries.name: write-bytevector
entries.doc: Write a half-open byte range and return nil.

entries.name: write-char
entries.doc: Write one Unicode scalar as UTF-8 and return nil.

entries.name: write-file
entries.doc: Write UTF-8 text to path, replacing its contents. Close the port on failure.

entries.name: write-string
entries.doc: Write a half-open character range as UTF-8; indexes cost O(end) on C. Return nil.

entries.name: write-to
entries.doc: Write readable forms separated by spaces to port and return nil.

entries.name: write-u8
entries.doc: Write an exact integer byte from 0 to 255 and return nil.

entries.name: zero?
entries.doc: Return #t when the argument is zero, otherwise #f.
